scope_limits: Bounded URL-access and source-provenance review, not a fresh technical fact-check of every sentence.
HTTP success alone does not prove that a requested document is delivered; redirects were inspected and the Intel homepage redirect was flagged.
Fragment-only distinctions were deduplicated; this audit does not assert that every fragment identifier exists.
No complete copyrighted documents were saved or redistributed by this audit. GET access probes read at most 8192 bytes; metadata/reference titles were checked using primary-source retrieval.
The 50 unique URLs reflect the 13-page snapshot at audit start. Root may replace links during integration; this report preserves the observed pre-fix findings.
